title: Stakeholder-advocate brief (engage-chorus Step 2)
description: One brief per dispatched stakeholder path. The six required fields (interests, statedPositions, batna, reservationPoint, tradeableConcessions, coalitionSignals) are the AC3 contract — missing any of them fails validation. role uniqueness across paths is enforced procedurally (AC6).

role.description: Kebab-case stakeholder role identifier (e.g., 'the-regulator', 'the-vendor', 'the-end-user'). Across all N paths, role must be unique — enforced procedurally before dispatch (AC6).

characterization.description: One-sentence characterization of this stakeholder in the situation.

interests.description: Underlying needs / motivations — NOT stated positions. Steel-man directive: real motivations, not strawman dismissals.

statedPositions.description: Current public stance — may diverge from interests.

batna.description: Best alternative to negotiated agreement — what happens if no deal is reached. Steel-man directive: BATNA must be non-trivial (not 'they have no alternative').

reservationPoint.description: Walk-away threshold — the worst deal this stakeholder accepts. Must reference specific terms or conditions.

tradeableConcessions.description: At least 2 concrete concessions this stakeholder can give up cheaply that are valuable to others. Steel-man directive: concrete and valuable, not generic.

alignedWith.description: Role identifier of another stakeholder whose interests align here.

coalitionSignals.description: At least one specific coalition signal naming another stakeholder and the shared interest. Steel-man directive: specific stakeholder name and basis, not vague 'others may agree'.

steelManTier.description: Classification by the primary agent. weak/inadequate triggers re-dispatch once (AC4); persistent failure tags steelMan=weak and mediator deprioritizes.

rationale.description: Optional ≤200-word narrative rationale explaining the advocate's framing choices.
